description: The Apple III, sos: a SOS.INTERP on a SOS 1.3 boot disk, which calls SOS, and which SOS loads at $2000 in the system bank and starts at its first byte, with its own zero page at $1A00.

reserved.why: SOS's low pages: the stack, the screen's text pages, the character set from $0C00, and SOS's and the interpreter's zero and extend pages, keyboard buffers and layout from $1400
SOS's kernel from $B800, with the I/O space and the boot ROM above it when SOS switches them in
